test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held on: 27 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Where is the National Dope Testing Laboratory located?
solution:
The correct answer is** __New Delhi__. **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__** The National Dope Testing Laboratory (NDTL) 

 
• It functions under the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.
 
• The NDTL in India was **established in 2008** to get permanently accredited by **International Olympic Committee (IOC) and World Anti Doping Agency** **(WADA)** to do the testing for the banned drugs in human sports.
 
• It is a dope testing lab aiming to get permanent accreditation from the World Anti-Doping Agency (WADA) and the International Olympic Committee (IOC).
 
• India signed the Copenhagen Declaration on Anti-Doping, post which it set up the National Anti-Doping Agency in December 2004.
 
• The National Dope Testing Lab is headed by the Chief Executive Officer, who is generally a Sports Secretary.
 
• National Anti Doping Agency is headed by the Director-General.
 
• Recently, NDTL was banned from carrying out any doping test for six months after it failed to meet the standards set up by the World Anti-Doping Agency (WADA).
 
• The Lab has completed sample testing for numerous major International as well as National events since its inception.
 
• The lab was earlier located in the Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium and is shifted to the new site on May 14, 2009, with better facilities.
 
• The area of the new NDTL lab is 2700 square meters as against the earlier area of only 900 square meters.
